name: apt-service-install
description: Practice-box helper: apt-get installs a package list and (optionally) enables+starts named units, to stand up an insecure/unwanted network service (telnet, rsh, tftp, cups, ...). Best-effort: needs the box to have package access at plant time. Vars: PACKAGES (required, space-separated); UNITS (optional, space-separated systemd units to enable --now). POST (optional): a shell command run after install/enable (e.g. update-inetd --enable telnet).
script:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
: "${PACKAGES:?PACKAGES is required}"
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
apt-get update -y >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
# shellcheck disable=SC2086
apt-get install -y $PACKAGES >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
for u in ${UNITS-}; do
  systemctl enable --now "$u" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  systemctl restart "$u" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
done
[ -n "${POST-}" ] && sh -c "$POST" || true
